summary.en: Three terminal windows stand along an arc in a dark 3D space; the camera holds on each while a command is typed and its output prints, pulling far back between them, and ends on one line in the accent.
summary.zh: 三个终端窗沿弧线立在暗色 3D 空间里，相机逐窗停留，看命令敲进、结果逐行打出，窗间远远拉开再飞，最后停在一行强调色上。

fits: A developer tool's workflow in three commands, ending on what it produced (demo, proof).
notFor: Graphical products (the windows are text); more than three steps; commands that must be read in full (the output is texture).

intent.en: A command-line workflow as a journey through a machine room: three commands, three stations, and a glimpse of the whole between them, ending on what was made.
intent.zh: 把命令行工作流拍成穿过机房的旅程：三条命令三个站，站间瞥见全貌，最后停在产出上。

content.en: Three stations, each a step name (≤ 12 chars, Chinese ≤ 4 characters), a short command (≤ 22 chars) and 2–4 output lines (key, value, note); an optional progress count and a READY line.
content.zh: 三站，每站一个步骤名（≤ 12 字符、中文 ≤ 4 字）、一条短命令（≤ 22 字符）和 2–4 行输出（键、值、备注）；可选进度计数和一行 READY 结尾。

fits.zh: 开发者工具三条命令的工作流，最后停在它的产出上（演示、证据）。

notFor.zh: 图形界面产品（窗里只有字）；多于三步；要逐字读完的命令（输出只是质感）。

en: Keep each command short with 2–4 output lines; long logs turn into noise.
Hold at least a second after the READY line, or the film has no landing.
zh: 命令要短、输出 2–4 行；长日志成了噪点。
READY 行出来后至少停一秒，否则没有落定。

upstream.name: 终端空间飞行
upstream.summary: 三个终端窗散布 3D 空间，相机窗间飞行、途中正弦拉远，每到一窗打字机敲命令、结果逐行滑出——命令执行的空间叙事流
upstream.use: 开发者产品的 CLI/工作流演示：把"三步命令"拍成三站空间旅程
upstream.energy: 中（飞行给动感、打字给节奏，整体是沉稳的技术叙事；收在 ● READY 一记亮点）
